notes.title: Linux version now available!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce we've released the Linux version of Kingdom Tales 2!

As far as our games are concerned, Linux is no longer a "second-class citizen", we're rolling out Linux support for ALL games in our catalogue and we will continue to support our games on all 3 major Steam platforms with updates from now on.

Everything works nicely, we tested the game on many Linux distributions as well as Steam Deck.
We built the game for Linux according to Steam developer guidelines so we don't expect much problems, but if you do encounter issues, please write in the Discussion forum and we'll investigate.

Also, if you play this game on Linux and everything works, we'd still love to hear from you and know which Distro/CPU/GPU you use.

notes.title: Kingdom Tales 2 Major Update Available Now
notes.notes:
We are happy to inform you that the game finally got an major update. Here's what you can find:
- MacOS supported (minimum 10.13)
- Steam Achievements
- Steam Cloud
- wide screens support
- bug fixes and stability improvements
- Languages + new ones added:
English
+ French
+ Italian
+ German
+ Spanish - Spain
+ Dutch
+ Czech
+ Polish
+ Japanese
+ Korean
+ Portuguese - Portugal
+ Russian
+ Simplified Chinese

notes.title: Explore the Wild West
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5646675/2ca45022f93c6858dfc32b126cbca0451c4ec9c8.jpg[/img]

Ted used to be a simple farmer. But he just couldn't see himself being a farmer his whole life. He wanted more. So Ted decided to leave for the big city and finish school there. Once he was done with his education, he decided it's finally time to find a job somewhere. And he found one in a small town called Sunset Hills. He got a job as an assistant in the mayor's office. This is how Ted and Catherine met! Even though he tried to hide it, he was smitten the first time he laid eyes on her. Unfortunately for Ted, the mayor himself was Catherine's fiancé. And the mayor... well, the mayor had some very ambitious plans for Sunset Hills. Or better said, some very ambitious plans for himself...

◾40 exciting levels to master 

◾Hundreds of Quests 

◾3 game modes (relaxed, timed and extreme) 

◾Explore the Wild West and meet peculiar characters 

◾Help Ted and his friends in their adventures
